name: Equipment
description: The military upgrade chain provides better equipment for your troops, as well as enabling the recruitment and construction of siege weapons.

variants.name: Armament Dump
variants.short: Whether made, found or stolen, our means are stored here.
variants.flavour: By necessity, the Tanukhids were a warlike people. Increasing Sassanid power in modern Yemen forced them south into the Gulf of Aqaba, where they became foederati of the Roman Empire. Although they learned much about warfare from the Romans, the Tanukhids couldn't rely on mass production for the arms and armour they needed, and instead mainly procured them from the battlefield following a victory. However, their guerrilla style of warfare suited this type of armament, particularly during their war against Rome; the Tanukhids would strike from the desert, defeat the Romans, take weapons and armour from the dead, then fade back into the inhospitable sands.

effects.text: Armour smithing I: +5% armour for all unit recruits
Shield crafting I: +5% shield effectiveness for shield-bearing unit recruits
Weaponsmithing I: +5% melee damage for all unit recruits

variants.name: Equipment Tents
variants.short: To weather combat's storm an army must be well stocked, prepared, and armed. To the teeth.
